narrative.title: Severe inflation adherence probe
narrative.summary: A minimal authored world whose only purpose is to probe condition adherence: inflation runs far above the historical average and nothing else is stressed.
narrative.lesson: Not a scenario for a user -- a WP2.2 Task 6 battery fixture exercising the inflation condition type at a severe intensity.

dispatches.headline: Inflation prints well above target
dispatches.detail: Nothing else in this world is deliberately stressed.

dispatches.headline: Prices stay elevated for years
dispatches.detail: A stagflation-adjacent average, without a scripted crisis.

dispatches.headline: The decade closes with inflation still high
dispatches.detail: The severe half of the adherence pair.
